rationale: Era's deep conviction in edge inference and open-source AI infrastructure aligns well with Sharon's focus on production-ready AI agent infrastructure—both are tackling the composable, on-device AI stack that Era believes will dominate. intro_message: Era Qian, meet Sharon — you're both building the next generation of production-grade, infrastructure-level AI systems; Sharon's work on agentic AI infrastructure and Era's conviction in sovereign, edge-deployed AI could spark something useful.
